race.comment: VALDER (6) sets the standard after making a sharp debut statement at Kempsey, winning a Maiden by three and a half lengths despite being forced wide and racing wide. She was near the top of betting there and comes straight to Class 1 level with scope to improve, although the wide barrier is the obvious new test. MESS AROUND (4) is the main danger on exposed talent, having won her only start at Tuncurry by just over a length on soft ground before a long break. Her close third in a recent Taree trial gives enough confidence she is ready to run well fresh. MIDWEST PRINCESS (7) brings the best recent Benchmark 58 form, finishing fourth at Grafton at her past two starts and beaten only two lengths last time. DIRTY DOES IT (3) is the other key hope, backing up quickly after a luckless fourth at Coffs Harbour when checked and beaten just over half a length.
